data.title: AI agents now control part of Deepmind's compute for Gemini experiments, but recursive self-improvement remains distant
data.description: Google Deepmind uses AI agents to run experiments on their own for upcoming Gemini models. Research chief Koray Kavukcuoglu says the lab is still far from recursive self-improvement. For oversight, Deepmind intentionally leaves the agents' internal chains of thought untrained so they can be reviewed. Kavukcuoglu measures AGI by everyday user trust rather than benchmarks.
data.author: Maximilian Schreiner
